apps.name: Clipboard+
apps.sub: Clipboard history & manager. Copy, save, search and paste on phone or PC.

apps.name: AutoStart+
apps.sub: Auto-launch your apps on boot. No root required, set once.

apps.name: FloatCalc+
apps.sub: A floating calculator with FX and unit converters, on top of any app.

apps.name: FloatTimer+
apps.sub: A floating timer, counter and stopwatch that stays over any app.

apps.name: VolumeBooster+
apps.sub: Volume booster and equalizer — one tap to 150%, up to 225%, and your device volume comes up with it.

apps.name: PhotoCleaner+
apps.sub: Hide personal info in photos & PDFs, fully on-device.

apps.name: ReadFocus+
apps.sub: A dyslexia & ADHD reading aid with line highlight & mask.

apps.name: FloatNote+
apps.sub: Sticky notes that float over any app. Collapse to a chip, expand to a card, with colors and rich text.

apps.name: Rotate+
apps.sub: Force screen rotation for the whole phone or per app — portrait, landscape or auto. No root.

apps.name: FloatPrompter+
apps.sub: A teleprompter that floats over camera and live-streaming apps, with mirror mode, remote control and voice follow.

apps.name: FloatWeb+
apps.sub: A floating browser that opens any website in a small window over your other apps, with tabs, bubbles and per-site settings.
